nodes.summary: An NPO problem $M$ is in APX when there are a rational number $\rho \ge 1$ and a polynomial-time computable map $A$ from bitstrings to bitstrings such that, for every instance $x$, the solution $A(x)$ is feasible for $x$ in $M$ and its value is at least $\mathrm{opt}_M(x) / \rho$, where $\mathrm{opt}_M(x)$ is the optimum of $M$ on $x$.
nodes.title: Membership in APX

nodes.summary: If $\mathsf{P} \ne \mathsf{NP}$, then for every rational $\varepsilon > 0$ there is no polynomial-time function $A$ from bitstrings to bitstrings such that, for every bitstring $x$, the bitstring $A(x)$ has the same length as $x$ and the MAX-3SAT value of the assignment $A(x)$ on $x$ is at least $(7/8 + \varepsilon)$ times the MAX-3SAT optimum of $x$.
nodes.title: Hastad: optimal inapproximability of MAX-3SAT

nodes.summary: A clause, given as a list of literals $(v, s)$ with variable index $v \in \mathbb{N}$ and polarity $s$, is nondegenerate if it has exactly three literals, its variable indices are pairwise distinct, and it contains no complementary pair, that is, no two literals $(v, s)$ and $(v, \lnot s)$.
nodes.title: Nondegenerate 3-clauses

nodes.summary: The MAX-3SAT optimum of a bitstring $x$ is the maximum, over all bitstrings $a$ of length $|x|$, of the MAX-3SAT value of $a$ on $x$.
nodes.title: Optimum of a MAX-3SAT instance

nodes.title: Value of a MAX-3SAT assignment

nodes.summary: Write $\mathrm{opt}_M(x)$ for the optimum of an NPO problem $M$ on an instance $x$ and $v_M(x, s)$ for the value of a solution $s$ for $x$. An NPO problem $M_1$ L-reduces to an NPO problem $M_2$ when there are polynomial-time computable maps $f$, from bitstrings to bitstrings, and $g$, from pairs of bitstrings to bitstrings, and rational numbers $\alpha > 0$ and $\beta > 0$, such that for every instance $x$ the…
nodes.title: L-reductions

nodes.summary: There is a MAXSNP problem whose value function is the MAX-3SAT value function and which is MAXSNP-complete: its underlying NPO problem is in APX, and the underlying NPO problem of every MAXSNP problem L-reduces to it.
nodes.title: MAX-3SAT is MAXSNP-complete

nodes.summary: The value of MAX-3SAT on an instance $x$ under an assignment $a$, both bitstrings, is defined as follows. Suppose $x$ decodes, under the canonical bitstring encoding, to a pair $(u, \varphi)$ of a bitstring $u$ and a CNF formula $\varphi$, and suppose moreover that $|a| \le |x|$, that every literal of $\varphi$ has variable index less than $|u|$ and that every clause of $\varphi$ has at most $3$ literals. nodes.title: The MAX-3SAT objective

nodes.summary: A MAXSNP problem $M$ is MAXSNP-complete when its underlying NPO problem is in APX and, for every MAXSNP problem $M'$, the underlying NPO problem of $M'$ L-reduces to the underlying NPO problem of $M$.
nodes.title: MAXSNP-completeness

nodes.title: MAXSNP problems

nodes.summary: An NPO (NP optimization) problem consists of a rational-valued value function $v$, a Boolean feasibility predicate $F$ and an objective encoding $e$, each taking an instance $x$ and a solution $s$ (both bitstrings), together with a polynomial $b$ with natural-number coefficients, such that the following hold. $F$ and $e$ are polynomial-time computable. nodes.title: NPO problems

nodes.summary: The optimum of an NPO problem $M$, with value function $v$ and solution length bound $b$, on an instance $x$ is the maximum of $v(x, s)$ over all bitstrings $s$ with $|s| \le b(|x|)$.
nodes.title: Optimum of an NPO problem

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
